assumptions.statement: Three-level scope and three key areas use provisional boundaries from official text description. Official polygons will change all area calculations.
assumptions.impact: All area-based metrics must be recalculated when official polygons are released.

assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls (FAR, height, density, green ratio, setbacks, road redlines) must be confirmed from official attachments.
assumptions.impact: Volume, height and density figures are conceptual directions, not approved controls.

assumptions.statement: Existing building footprints, height, floor counts and land ownership are not available from public sources.
assumptions.impact: Retain/renovate/demolish conclusions are method frameworks pending survey data.

assumptions.statement: Road redlines, cross-sections, rail station boundaries, and parking supply need official traffic data.
assumptions.impact: Traffic conclusions are directional pending official data.

assumptions.statement: Utility lines, drainage, power, gas, fire access, flood control and sponge-city targets need engineering data.
assumptions.impact: Municipal conclusions are directional pending engineering study.

assumptions.statement: Heritage protection scope and control zones (e.g., Qinghua Garden Station) need official GIS layers.
assumptions.impact: Heritage-related controls are directional pending official data.

assumptions.statement: OSM background cross-check (Issue #846) is used only for rough context, not official boundaries.
assumptions.impact: OSM results are not promoted to official claims.

assumptions.statement: All activities, investment, policy and operation arrangements are conceptual suggestions, not confirmed government arrangements.
assumptions.impact: No operational claim is stated as confirmed.
